CREDIT AGREEMENT
SERTA-STYLE BORROWER (Priming Risk Structure)
Dated: November 2024

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ARTICLE VII - NEGATIVE COVENANTS
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Section 7.12. Incremental Facilities and Additional Debt.

(a) Incremental Debt Baskets. The Borrower may, at any time and from time to time,
    incur additional Indebtedness in the form of Incremental Term Loans, Incremental
    Revolving Commitments, or other Incremental Facilities (collectively, "Incremental
    Debt"), in an aggregate principal amount not to exceed the sum of:
    
    (i) $300,000,000 (the "Free and Clear Basket"); plus
    
    (ii) an unlimited amount, so long as, after giving pro forma effect to the
        incurrence of such Incremental Debt and the use of proceeds therefrom, the
        Secured Net Leverage Ratio does not exceed 5.00 to 1.00 (the "Ratio Basket").

(b) Priority and Security. Any Incremental Debt may, at the sole election of the
    Borrower:
    
    (i) rank pari passu in right of payment and security with the existing First
        Lien Term Loans (the "Existing First Lien Debt"); or
    
    (ii) rank senior in right of payment or security to the Existing First Lien Debt
        (so-called "super-priority" or "priming" debt); or
    
    (iii) rank junior in right of payment or security to the Existing First Lien Debt.

(c) No Consent Required. The incurrence of any Incremental Debt pursuant to this
    Section 7.12 shall NOT require the consent or approval of:
    
    (i) any existing Lender (other than the Lenders who elect to provide such
        Incremental Debt, the "Incremental Lenders");
    
    (ii) the Administrative Agent (other than with respect to administrative and
        documentation matters);
    
    (iii) any other Person.
    
    For the avoidance of doubt, minority Lenders under the Existing First Lien Debt
    may be primed or subordinated by the incurrence of Incremental Debt without their
    consent, so long as the Required Lenders (Lenders holding more than 50% of the
    outstanding principal amount) do not object.

(d) Use of Proceeds. The proceeds of Incremental Debt may be used for any corporate
    purpose, including without limitation:
    
    (i) acquisitions and investments;
    
    (ii) refinancing of existing debt;
    
    (iii) restricted payments and dividends;
    
    (iv) general corporate purposes.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Section 10.01. Amendments and Waivers; Required Lenders.

(a) Required Lender Consent. Amendments to this Credit Agreement require the consent
    of Required Lenders (Lenders holding more than 50% of the aggregate outstanding
    principal amount of the Term Loans).

(b) Unanimous Consent. The following amendments require the consent of ALL Lenders
    (100% unanimous consent):
    
    (i) reduce the principal amount of any Loan;
    
    (ii) reduce the rate of interest on any Loan;
    
    (iii) extend the maturity date of any Loan;
    
    (iv) release all or substantially all of the Collateral (other than as expressly
         permitted by this Agreement or any Intercreditor Agreement).

(c) Sacred Rights NOT Protected. Notably, the following amendments do NOT require
    unanimous Lender consent and may be approved by Required Lenders (>50%):
    
    (i) modifications to lien priority or the relative priority of security interests;
    
    (ii) addition of pari passu or senior Incremental Facilities that prime existing
         Lenders;
    
    (iii) amendments to the payment waterfall or distribution of collateral proceeds;
    
    (iv) amendments to intercreditor agreements or subordination provisions.

PRIMING RISK ANALYSIS:
• $300M free-and-clear basket - NO LEVERAGE TEST REQUIRED
• Unlimited ratio basket at 5.0x - UNCAPPED IF TEST MET
• Pari passu OR super-priority permitted - PRIMING EXPLICITLY ALLOWED
• No consent required from existing Lenders - MINORITY SQUEEZE
• Required Lenders (>50%) can modify lien priority - NO SACRED RIGHTS
• Classic "Serta-style" priming risk structure
• Precedent: Serta Simmons Minority Lender Litigation
• PRIMING RISK SCORE: 9.0/10.0 (CRITICAL)
